tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /brtan bzhugs nor bu'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po sa skya pa/ /'jam mgon mkhas pa'i dbang po grub pa'i rje/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'gro kun dga' ba'i dpal/ /bsod nams mtshan can zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog /sprul pa'i zhing du rig 'dzin dpal seng ge /bod rgyal chos kyi blon po mgar stong btsan/ /rnam gsum sprul pa zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can 'dir/ /lo paṇa du mar skye ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ /thub bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i rnam 'gyur gyi/ /ngo mtshar ston mkhas zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /dhīḥyig 'od phung 'bar ba'i ti la ka /lang tshor smin legs blo gros gsal ba'i dpal/ /'khon rigs chos kyi rgyal thabs chen po'i gdung / /bsam bzhin bzung khyod zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /sngon goms bag chags bzang po'i tshon ris brgya/ /mkhyen yangs thugs kyi me long la 'phos pas/ /gzhon nu nyid nas 'jam dpal gzhon nu yi/ /ngang tshul gsal khyod zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /bshes gnyen du ma'i legs bshad chu klung kun/ /rnam dpyod thugs mtshor 'khyil ba'i klong zab mor/ /lung rtogs nor bu gdengs ka'i rtser 'dzin pa/ /smra ba'i klu dbang zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /rab 'byams lhag pa'i lha tshogs 'dus pa'i dpyid/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon dang rnam dbyer med/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos bran bgyid pa'i/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /srid tshul nyes pa'i nad rnams zhi byed pa'i/ /sman gyi mchog tu yongs grub dam pa'i chos/ /zab rgyas ci dgar 'gyed pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /sman pa'i rgyal po zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /dpal ldan sa skya zhes bya bod yul gyi/ /rdo rje gdan la skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin/

/mngon mdzad chos rje zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /gtsug lag lugs brgya'i dge mtshan ji snyed pa/ /nyams pa gso dang gsar du skrun pa'i phyag /ring du brkyangs des ris med 'gro ba kun/ /mchog tu rnam 'dren zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rin chen gdugs dkar po/ /g.yas su bskor ba'i grib mas 'jig rten gsum/ /kun khyab bsil ba'i go 'phang la reg pa'i/ /bde legs chen pos phyogs kun gang gyur cig /ces rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdung rabs dri ma med pa'i 'phreng ba mngon par bstar ba'i mdo 'dzin yid bzhin gyi nor bu ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs sen legs byas kyi 'dab brgya rnam par bzhad pa'i dge mtshan dus las mi yol zhing / rtag brtan g.yung drung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ ji srid bskal pa chen po'i bar g.yo ba med par gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bde 'byung gi grangs kyis 'khyud pa/ snyan tshig gi rgyan dam pos ma bcings par mkhas blun yongs kyi go bder sbyar ba 'di ni/ rnam par dpyod pa'i nor ldan lang tsho gsar pa'i dpal la reg pa'i zla tshes gzhon nu gang gis bskul ba bzhin ri khrod pa buddha'i ming can gyis mgyogs bris su bkod pa phyogs dus thams cad las dzayastu/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //legs bshad shel gyi tambu ra/ /mgrin pa'i skyed tshal 'dir sbrengs tshe/ /dri za'i glu dang lhan cig tu/ /dbyangs can ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo/ /grong tshig rkang par bcad pa la/ /snyan ngag ming bzang btags nas ci/ /rgyan mang mdzes sdug gis sgeg pa'i/ /gar 'dis 'jam mgon dgyes gyur cig /ces kyang smras so// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ brtan bzhugs nor bu'i 'khri shing / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
